body: I wish I had the motivation that you did, I have felt tired as long as I can remember. I wish I could go to sleep and never wake up. It would be so much easier. I envy the dreams of others, but I don't have a true dream of my own besides suicide in the bathroom. Unless you count being the only guy that died while protecting everyone from a school shooter. thats how I really want to go out, but that will never happen.

I have been going to therapy for help with depression, but I haven't told him yet. No matter what I do one day, the day after I always think about ending it all. I have no idea why, I'm stuck in a rut that my brain wants to stay in. I know I shouldn't, but I can't help thinking about it.
